outcome: Maternal co-morbidities (drug abuse, pre-existing diabetes, etc.)
Obstetric interventions (Caesarean delivery, prolonged hospital stay)
finding: While many maternal co-morbidities and obstetric interventions varied at the area-level, only some were associated with area-level SES, suggesting other area-level factors are also relevant.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was less likely to occur in the most deprived areas compared to the least deprived areas.
